item.title: Holiday heatwave likely sets records
item.description: Christmas week is expected to be the warmest on record across the Ozarks, with temperatures reaching near record highs and humidity levels increasing, resulting in warm, humid, and windy conditions.

item.title: Last big meteor shower of the year peaks tonight
item.description: The Ursid meteor shower is underway from December 17th to December 26th, peaking on Monday morning, and can be viewed from a rural location with minimal light pollution.
